advisory.correction: Keep the tier list (lines 63 to 70) in `SKILL.md`, because the reference files use the tiers that `SKILL.md` defines. advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: In each job, also for a small change, do the vote of the confirmers that `references/review.md` gives. Do the vote also when you expect to reject the findings.
advisory.problem: Step 8 at skills/writing/agent-instructions/SKILL.md line 103 repeats the pointer target skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 168, which tells the agent to do the vote in each job, also for a small change, and also when it expects to reject the findings.
advisory.correction: "Before the self-check, read `references/review.md`. Then do the self-check that it gives, with the vote of the confirmers. For a list file, start no loading reviewer in the self-check."

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: In the other jobs, after the self-check, do the reader test that `references/review.md` gives, also for a small change. The self-check does not examine how a new reader obeys the file.
advisory.problem: Step 9 at skills/writing/agent-instructions/SKILL.md line 104 repeats the pointer target skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 209, which tells the agent to do the reader test in each job, also for a small change, and gives the same cause.
advisory.correction: "In the other jobs, after the self-check, do the reader test that `references/review.md` gives."

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: Do not give a list file to the readers, because a list file gives no task to test.
advisory.problem: Step 9 at skills/writing/agent-instructions/SKILL.md line 104 repeats the pointer target skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 211, which tells the agent that the reader test does not examine a list file and to give the readers only the files that are not list files.

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: For a list file, do no output test, no load test, and no manual check.
advisory.problem: Step 10 at skills/writing/agent-instructions/SKILL.md line 105 repeats the pointer target skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 320, which tells the agent to select no output test, no load test, and no manual check for a list file.

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: In a review round, the first 2 confirmers of a reviewer get all blocking findings of that reviewer.
advisory.problem: The confirmer term at skills/writing/agent-instructions/SKILL.md line 27 repeats the vote procedure of the pointer target skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md lines 170 to 173, which gives the first 2 confirmers, the third confirmer, and their findings.
advisory.correction: "A **confirmer** is a new subagent that answers "yes" or "no", with one sentence, for each problem in its prompt. These problems come from a check other than the confirmer. A confirmer gets the rule, the quoted text, and the files, but not the cause that the other check gives. The number of "yes" answers that confirm a problem depends on the check that found the problem."
